# nfl_simple_model REFIT tables (generated by `scripts/nfl_simple_model.py refit`)

Live coefficients fit on 2020-2025 with recency weight half-life 2.0 seasons. 2020-2025 used to fit live coefficients -> L33 sealed test FORFEITED; L33 forward-paper only.

MAE/bias are model minus nflverse CLOSING line (data/nfl_games.parquet). RMSE is vs the actual outcome. Accuracy only: no betting result is scored here.

Closing lines joined per season: {2020: 269, 2021: 285, 2022: 284, 2023: 285, 2024: 285, 2025: 285, 2026: 105}
